bullets.id: Emas spot membuka pekan dengan naik sekitar 1,3% (+$52,71) ke sekitar $4.123 di perdagangan Asia, memulihkan penurunan Jumat setelah payroll panas. Harga minyak melemah setelah Trump menyebut serangan baru ke Iran sangat kecil kemungkinannya selama perundingan berlangsung, sehingga tekanan inflasi dari energi sedikit mereda.
bullets.en: Spot gold opened the week up about 1.3% (+$52.71) to around $4,123 in Asian trade, recovering Friday’s post-payrolls drop. Oil eased after Trump said fresh strikes on Iran were highly unlikely while talks continue, taking some of the energy-driven inflation pressure off.

bullets.id: Kenaikan ini tetap dibatasi ekspektasi Fed: pasar memperkirakan peluang sekitar 80–81% kenaikan bunga 25 bp pada Desember, naik dari sekitar 70% sebelum laporan payroll. Yield 10 tahun di sekitar 4,885% dan indeks dolar sekitar 102,16. Emas masih sekitar 26,5% di bawah rekor $5.608,35 dari Januari dan sekitar 1,2% lebih rendah dalam sebulan.
bullets.en: The gain is still capped by Fed expectations: markets see about an 80–81% chance of a 25 bp hike in December, up from about 70% before the payrolls report. The 10-year yield is near 4.885% and the dollar index near 102.16. Gold is still about 26.5% below January’s $5,608.35 record and about 1.2% lower on the month.

bullets.id: Emas kini di atas resistance $4.089 yang dicatat Kitco; zona berikutnya $4.150–$4.170, dekat puncak pekan lalu di $4.147,02. Support awal di $4.032 lalu $4.016, dengan $4.000 sebagai pivot penting. Ujian utama adalah CPI Oktober pada Selasa 10 November, yang hanya memuat perubahan bulanan: nowcast Cleveland Fed 0,24% (inti 0,21%), RBC 0,3% untuk keduanya.
bullets.en: Gold is now above the $4,089 resistance Kitco flagged; the next zone is $4,150–$4,170, near last week’s $4,147.02 peak. Initial support is $4,032 then $4,016, with $4,000 as the key pivot. The main test is October CPI on Tuesday 10 November, which carries only monthly changes: the Cleveland Fed nowcast sees 0.24% (core 0.21%), RBC 0.3% for both.

bullets.id: Antam 1 gram bertahan di Rp2.545.000 pada Senin dengan buyback Rp2.350.000 (spread Rp195.000, sekitar 7,7%), belum mencerminkan lonjakan spot pagi ini. Galeri24 tetap Rp2.507.000 (buyback Rp2.360.000, spread sekitar 5,9%) dan UBS Rp2.540.000 (buyback Rp2.334.000, sekitar 8,1%). Galeri24 masih Rp38.000 lebih murah dari Antam.
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram price held at Rp2,545,000 on Monday with buyback at Rp2,350,000 (a Rp195,000 spread, about 7.7%), not yet reflecting this morning’s jump in spot. Galeri24 is unchanged at Rp2,507,000 (buyback Rp2,360,000, a spread of about 5.9%) and UBS at Rp2,540,000 (buyback Rp2,334,000, about 8.1%). Galeri24 is still Rp38,000 cheaper than Antam.
